extra.ground_truth: The first YouTube video was "Me at the zoo", a 19-second clip filmed at the San Diego Zoo, uploaded by co-founder Jawed Karim in April 2005 (April 23, 2005).

messages.content: You are a research agent that answers factual questions using a web search tool. Decompose the question, verify each fact against at least two independent sources, and synthesize a concise sourced answer.
What was the first video ever uploaded to YouTube, who uploaded it, and in what month and year?
Well-known trivia: "Me at the zoo" by co-founder Jawed Karim. Confirming the date, April 2005.

1. Me at the zoo — Wikipedia — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo
   "Me at the zoo" is the first video uploaded to YouTube, on April 23, 2005, by co-founder Jawed Karim.

2. YouTube's first video turns 18 — https://www.theverge.com/youtube-me-at-the-zoo-anniversary
   The 19-second clip shows Karim at the San Diego Zoo elephant enclosure.

3. Jawed Karim — Wikipedia — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jawed_Karim
   Karim uploaded the first YouTube video after co-founding the site with Chad Hurley and Steve Chen.
Verifying with two independent sources since anniversary articles sometimes shift the date.
